name: Jodah
aliases: Archmage Eternal of the School of the Unseen
description: Jodah is a powerful Dominarian archmage over four thousand years old, whose aging was slowed by a Fountain of Youth and who is known as the Archmage Eternal.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

summary.text: Jodah is a powerful Dominarian archmage over four thousand years old, whose aging was slowed by a Fountain of Youth and who is known as the Archmage Eternal.

bio.text: After the Battle of Pitdown he hid in a Fountain of Youth, which slowed his aging to a crawl.

citations.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Southern City-States", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He and Sima freed Lord Ith from his cage at the Conclave of Mages, Ith killed Mairsil and then destroyed the Conclave, and the surviving mages followed Jodah and Sima to the City of Shadows.

citations.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Jodah became Archmage and married Sima, but outlived her and sank into grief.

citations.text: "Jodah", section "Archmage of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Sima", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Ice Age his own students Gerda and Gustha sold him to Lim-Dul, who clouded his mind in Tresserhorn until Jaya Ballard rescued him.

citations.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: With Jaya he foiled the Knights of Stromgald's coup against King Darien, dueled Lim-Dul until Leshrac took him away, and lent his mirror to Freyalise's World Spell, which ended the Ice Age.

citations.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At Soldev, Jaya, possessed by Mairsil, stabbed him and his blood activated the war beasts, until he smashed his mirror in her face, which triggered her planeswalker spark; Jodah then let his name fade into legend.

citations.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the Dominaria United story he presided over the peace summit that Karn and Teferi interrupted with news of the Phyrexian invasion, fought as a leader of the New Coalition, and delivered Jaya's eulogy.

citations.text: "Jodah", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Jodah", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In The Brothers' War he learned he descends from Urza, entered Urza's Starfield Orb pocket dimension, and was stabbed by Rona at Urza's Tower.

status.text: Alive: after the blast at Urza's Tower he staggered back in alive and stayed to free Teferi, though he was grievously wounded by Rona.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal army led by Primate Delphine attacks the citadel while Jodah and Sima free Lord Ith.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Sima freeing Lord Ith from his cage.

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Flarg goblins surprise-attack the forces at the Battle of Pitdown.
timeline.quote: they made a surprise attack on the fighting forces of Ghed and Alsoor

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Terisiare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sima meets her future husband Jodah during a search beyond the city.
timeline.quote: This is how Sima , a member of the school, met her future husband Jodah .

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Conclave falls to Lord Ith, surviving mages including Jodah and Shannan travel to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: making it the sole remaining school of magic on Terisiare

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Rivalry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya Ballard prevent an attack by the Knights of Stromgald on Darien and reveal Lim-Dûl's involvement.
timeline.quote: prevented an attack on Darien's life by the Knights of Stromgald and revealed that Lim-Dûl was behind it

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Darien consolidates his power, forms a single army under General Varchild, and allies with the Balduvians against Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: This allowed him to make an alliance with the Balduvians and lead an army against Lim-Dûl

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twenty years into the Thaw, Darien and Lovisa merge their nations into New Argive and fight the Battle of Kjeldor.
timeline.quote: planned for their two nations to be merged into New Argive

citation.text: "Darien Kjeld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah helps Freyalise through her ascension.
timeline.quote: Her ascension drove her nearly mad, but she was helped by Jodah

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise casts the World Spell to end the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: she cast the World Spell to end the Ice Age.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah convinces Darien and Lovisa Coldeyes to stop fighting and cooperate, leading to the merger into New Argive.
timeline.quote: This cooperation would eventually result in the merger of the two countries into New Argive

citation.text: "Kjeldor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Klazina is saved from the ghoul Klausson by Jodah's fireball and leads the counterattack.
timeline.quote: She was saved by Jodah casting a fireball to immolate the former Sacred Torch leader

citation.text: "Klazina Jansdotter", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerda sells out Jodah, and Lim-Dûl muddles his memory and makes him research planes and ways to kill a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl had Jodah also research ways to kill a planeswalker

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah escapes with Jaya Ballard and they seek to unite Kjeldor with the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: Jodah escaped with the aid of his old friend Jaya Ballard

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl poisons the Knights of Stromgald when they plot a coup, zombifying them; Jodah saves King Darien and Kjeldor allies with the Balduvians.
timeline.quote: allowed Darien to unite them and forge an alliance with the Balduvians

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Lim-Dûl faces Jodah under Mairsil's control, and Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dûl's hand and tears him apart.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was turned into a living ball of raw flesh that Leshrac took with him off-plane

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerda trades Jodah to Lim-Dûl for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn, giving her access to a pool of black mana.
timeline.quote: In a bid for power, she exchanged Jodah in return for the Bottomless Pit of Tresserhorn .

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl is defeated; Jodah survives and returns to rule, with Gerda as his second-in-command as punishment.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was defeated in Lim-Dûl's Battle , but Jodah survived his ordeal and returned to rule the school

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah leaves with Jaya Ballard to hunt Mairsil-Lim-Dûl's spirit, leaving Gerda in charge.
timeline.quote: Jodah left with Jaya Ballard to track down the remainder of Mairsil -Lim-Dûl's spirit and left Gerda in charge of the school.

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerda and Ozmar leave Lat-Nam for good; Jodah grants Gerda the position of Archmage of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: she was legally granted the position of Archmage of the Unseen by Jodah

citation.text: "School of the Unseen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah is captured by the Inquisition, who kill his mentor Voska, and flees to Alsoor.
timeline.quote: First, he is captured by the Inquisition, who killed his mentor Voska .

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah joins the army and survives the Battle of Pitdown by hiding in a Fountain of Youth.
timeline.quote: he has to hide in a Fountain of Youth to avoid being killed by goblin raiders

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets Sima; their ship is hit by a storm and Jodah is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man, who leads him to the Conclave of Mages.
timeline.quote: he falls overboard and is abducted by merfolk working for the Rag Man

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah discovers Mairsil has usurped the Conclave from Lord Ith and keeps him caged to drain his powers.
timeline.quote: Mairsil has usurped control of the Conclave from its founder, Lord Ith

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith, who kills Mairsil and then is restored by seeing his reflection in Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: The insane wizard kills Mairsil

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith leaves on his own; Jodah and Sima take the remaining wizards from the destroyed Conclave to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: Ith decides to leave and be on his own

citation.text: "The Gathering Dark", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya fails to steal from Jodah's chambers; sensing her magic he lets her study at the School of the Unseen, but she leaves to be a task mage.
timeline.quote: Sensing magical capabilities in her, Jodah allowed Jaya to study in the School of the Unseen at Lat-Nam

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya finds Jodah missing and follows the trail to Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: Eventually, the trail led to Tresserhorn .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya rescues Jodah, who was drugged by Lim-Dûl, and summons Freyalise, promising her the school's resources for her World Spell.
timeline.quote: She destroyed the pollen-bearing flower and rescued him

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya brings Jodah Lim-Dûl's hand with the ring finger missing, and they search for the ring.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Jaya set out to search for the missing ring

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wearing the ruby ring, Jaya is possessed by Mairsil and cuts Jodah's throat, but Jodah survives and shatters his mirror in her face.
timeline.quote: She cut Jodah's throat, using his blood to revive the Phyrexian war beasts.

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Her planeswalker spark flares, Jaya erases Mairsil's presence and destroys the war beasts, then helps seal the pit and relocate the school.
timeline.quote: Jaya's planeswalker spark flared.

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya gives Jodah an amulet to keep him sane and long-lived and leaves Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She then departed Dominaria for the wider multiverse .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerda and Gustha kidnap Jodah and give him to Lim-Dûl, who imprisons him in Tresserhorn and clouds his mind with Fyndhorn Pollen.
timeline.quote: They gave him to the necromancer Lim-Dûl , who imprisoned Jodah in Tresserhorn

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya Ballard rescues Jodah, and she calls upon Freyalise to cure him, putting them in the planeswalker's debt.
timeline.quote: Jaya called upon Freyalise to cure him

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya warn Kjeld; the Knights of Stromgald's coup fails and King Darien is convinced.
timeline.quote: the threat convinced King Darien of the truth in Jodah's warnings

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, until Leshrac cuts off Dûl's hand and takes him to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Leshrac took him to Phyrexia to be recreated

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah's mirror is used in the World Spell that ends the Ice Age, and he disperses the effect through the safe havens, destroying them.
timeline.quote: Jodah was forced to disperse the effect of the spell through the safe havens , destroying them all

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya shows Jodah Lim-Dûl's severed hand with the ring finger missing and they set out to find the ring.
timeline.quote: the hand of Lim-Dûl and the ring finger were missing

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Soldev, Jaya, vessel of Mairsil/Dûl, stabs Jodah, and the Adnates use his blood to activate the War Beasts, which level Soldev and the School of the Unseen.
timeline.quote: Jaya stabbed Jodah fatally, revealing that she had been the new vessel of Mairsil/Dûl all along

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah smashes his mirror in Jaya's face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl and triggering Jaya's spark.
timeline.quote: smashed his mirror in Jaya's face

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya ascends as a planeswalker and helps defeat the Beasts; Jodah chooses not to rebuild the School and hides behind legends.
timeline.quote: Jodah opted to spread rumors and lies about himself to hide behind myths and legends

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Shattered Alliances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mairsil's ring coerces Jaya into picking it up; the possessed Jaya stabs Jodah at Soldev and destroys Soldev and the School of the Unseen, until Jaya ascends and expels the minds.
timeline.quote: Jaya ascended and removed the minds of Lim-Dûl and Mairsil from herself.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Shattered Alliance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya return in 2954 AR and destroy the Lord of Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: But Jodah and Jaya returned there in 2954 AR , and destroyed the Lord of Tresserhorn.

citation.text: "Tresserhorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah awakens at Tresserhorn and is told he is a summoned copy who must obey Lim-Dûl.
timeline.quote: The necromancer tells him he's a summoned copy of the original Jodah

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets the zombified Márton Stromgald.
timeline.quote: Stromgald has been zombified

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac mutates Lim-Dûl, revealing he forced the necromancer into his service.
timeline.quote: Leshrac mutates the necromancer by making him more animalistic and giving him horns

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya reveals Jodah is the real Jodah, drugged by Lim-Dûl, and they escape Tresserhorn.
timeline.quote: Jodah is not a summoned being but the real thing

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah goes mad; Jaya summons Freyalise, who explains his periodic madness and offers a cure for a price.
timeline.quote: Jodah goes completely mad

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya steals Jodah's mirror in Krov and learns Gustha and Gerda sold Jodah to Lim-Dûl; she cures Jodah with it.
timeline.quote: Gustha and her cousin Gerda Äagesdotter were the ones who sold out Jodah to the necromancer

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya discovers Avram Garrison's plot to overthrow King Darien and warns Varchild, Jodah and Gustha, who foil the coup.
timeline.quote: they manage to foil the coup

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah puts Gerda in charge of the School of the Unseen as punishment.
timeline.quote: Jodah puts Gerda in charge

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise takes Jodah's mirror as payment for healing him.
timeline.quote: demands the last payment for healing Jodah: to borrow his mirror

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah fights Lim-Dûl, revealed to be a blend of himself and Mairsil the Pretender; Lim-Dûl summons Leshrac, who rips him apart and takes him to the rogue plane.
timeline.quote: Leshrac rips the necromancer to shreds but keeps him alive during it all

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With their master gone, the undead drop; Freyalise invites Jodah to Fyndhorn and enlists him to vent a reverse Sylex Blast through the safe havens.
timeline.quote: Freyalise is planning to use the arrival of the rogue plane to create another Sylex Blast

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the World Spell is complete, Freyalise returns the mirror and planeswalks away; the planeswalkers leave and Jodah and Jaya wonder what the new world holds.
timeline.quote: After the World Spell is complete, Freyalise gives Jodah his mirror back and planeswalks away.

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Twenty years later Jaya shows Jodah the blackened hand of Dul, claiming to have found it in a Soldev market.
timeline.quote: She shows him the blackened hand of Dûl which she claims to have found in a market in Soldev .

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya find at Tresserhorn only Chaeska and her undead Lord of Tresserhorn, and Jodah notes the Bottomless Pit has disappeared.
timeline.quote: Jodah realizes this is a dead-end but does discover that the Bottomless Pit under Tresserhorn has disappeared.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya meet Lovisa's Balduvians, who say the Kjeldorans are raiding them, and Jaya takes Lim-Dul's finger from a shaman.
timeline.quote: Jaya sees one of the Balduvian shamans carrying Lim-Dûl's finger as a talisman

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Kjeld Jodah is attacked by a Phantasmal Fiend sent by Lim-Dul; Jaya falls ill.
timeline.quote: Then Jaya suddenly falls very ill.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah holds off a Kjeldoran siege of the Balduvians until Darien's army arrives, discovers the attacker is Varchild, and negotiates peace laying the groundwork for New Argive.
timeline.quote: Jodah lays the groundwork for New Argive

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Soldevi Sentry attacks Jodah and Jaya, and Jodah finds his mirror now magnifies spells.
timeline.quote: Jodah discovers that his mirror now not only reflects spells but also magnifies their force

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Beneath Soldev, Lim-Dul reveals himself as Jaya, stabs Jodah in the throat, and uses his blood to activate the War Beasts, which destroy Soldev.
timeline.quote: There Lim-Dûl reveals himself: all this time he had been Jaya!

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freyalise offers to make Jodah a planeswalker, but he realizes he has no spark and heals himself.
timeline.quote: He quickly gathers the mana for a healing spell and jumps back to his body, healing himself at the last possible moment.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah chooses to save his friend over his school; he smashes the mirror into Jaya's face and she ascends as a planeswalker, purging Dul and Mairsil.
timeline.quote: she indeed ascends, purging Dûl and Mairsil from her mind

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The School of the Unseen is mostly reduced to rubble; Gerda leads survivors east, Jaya leaves, and Jodah disappears from history.
timeline.quote: Jodah himself decides to disappear from the history books.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the epilogue, 300 years later, Jodah goes to Urza's cottage in the Ohran Mountains to tell him what happened.
timeline.quote: This person is Urza , a planeswalker desperately in need of someone who can cure his insanity.

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah helps restore Urza to sanity.
timeline.quote: played an important role in restoring Urza to sanity

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Later appearances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets Jhoira at Urborg and joins her quest, beginning a relationship that did not work out.
timeline.quote: They began a relationship, but it didn't work out.

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Later appearances". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Venser go to Urborg to seek Lord Windgrace; Venser is captured by Windgrace and Jhoira meets Jodah, who explains the Weaver King.
timeline.quote: Venser is captured by Lord Windgrace while Jhoira encounters Jodah

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Windgrace consults Teferi, who deduces the Phyrexians come from an alternate reality; Windgrace takes the group to the Blind Eternities to meet Freyalise, and they decide to pursue the rifts independently.
timeline.quote: Windgrace and Freyalise decide to pursue each rift independently.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King follows Jodah and Venser to Skyshroud and takes control of the slivers and Phyrexians; Freyalise channels all her mana into the rift, closing it and consuming herself.
timeline.quote: closing it but completely consuming herself in the process.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group disbands; Radha returns to Keld, Teferi to Jamuraa, Jhoira seeks Jodah, and Venser makes his first planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Venser, now a planeswalker in his own right, makes his first planeswalk into the unknown.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira exposes Raff's lie about Jodah.
timeline.quote: Jodah did not say that.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira tenses when she sees her ex-lover Jodah at the academy.
timeline.quote: Just an ex-lover I wasn't expecting to see today.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah, Dean Naban and Tolarian mages meet the Weatherlight's group.
timeline.quote: In the lead were an older man with hard features and a deceptively young-looking mage with a mane of brown hair.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah brings them to see something at the academy.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure how much we can help you, but there's something we'd like you to take a look at.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana animates a dead student to question it; nine victims were killed by dementia magic.
timeline.quote: Lying on the floor were nine corpses, students and staff of the academy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the laboratory itself was the agent's target.
timeline.quote: This place was the target all along.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah finds the box holding the ancient artifact empty.
timeline.quote: It's gone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: A student named Thom emerges and claims he was studying.
timeline.quote: I'm Thom, studying artificing with Dr. Arongi.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Thom sends a globe of death magic at Jodah.
timeline.quote: A dark globe of death magic appeared in the air and shot across the room toward Jodah.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira shatters the globe with a barrier.
timeline.quote: Jhoira moved so fast it was like she had teleported.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah paralyzes Thom.
timeline.quote: He's harmless now,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah asks Jhoira to stay and help hunt Cabal cultists, and she refuses.
timeline.quote: You could stay here and help us.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Barl interviews Jodah, and Mairsil recognizes Jarsyl's name and assigns Jodah to the library.
timeline.quote: Mairsil told Barl that Jodah was to work in the library.

citation.text: "Barl", section "Meeting with Jodah". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mairsil and Barl plot to make Jodah kill Sima in a proxy duel, and Barl prepares both mages.
timeline.quote: The idea was to get Jodah to kill Sima.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima duel and Jodah wins, and Mairsil goes to finish Sima.
timeline.quote: Three days later, Jodah and Sima clashed.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barl catches Jodah and Sima together, threatens them with his crossbow, and Sima unravels it with blue magic so Barl flees.
timeline.quote: Deprived of his weapon, Barl fled.

citation.text: "Barl", section "Barl's fate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jhoira searches for Jodah and they become romantically involved, but it does not last.
timeline.quote: they would become romantically involved

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Dating Jodah". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah bathes in a long-abandoned Fountain of Youth in Pitdown, slowing his aging to a crawl.
timeline.quote: The magical waters of this fountain slowed down his aging to a crawl

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah is traded to the Rag Man and taken to the Conclave of Mages, where he passes Mairsil's test.
timeline.quote: Jodah succeeded in the test that Mairsil , the ruler of the Conclave, had set for him

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During a Church of Tal assault Jodah frees Ith, who rampages and kills Mairsil and the Rag Man, then is calmed by Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: Ith, who had been driven insane by his time over the Pit, go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith tears apart the Conclave and the mages follow Jodah and Sima to the City of Shadows.
timeline.quote: the mages followed Jodah and Sima to the City of Shadows

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah becomes Archmage and marries Sima, but outlives her and sinks into grief, storing his memories in his mirror.
timeline.quote: he began to store his memories in his mirror, wipe his memory clean, and then restore the memories from the mirror

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Archmage of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani warn Jodah, Jaya and the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but are met with doubt.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have returned to Dominaria.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya refuse to halt negotiations without a location for the Phyrexians but promise to help afterward.
timeline.quote: "We will go with you, Karn," said Jaya.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Radha and Aron are about to sign the peace when Teferi arrives with news that the Phyrexians were on Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: "It's the Phyrexians—they were on Kamigawa."

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The news of the Phyrexian threat unsettles the summit, and the signing of the peace is left uncertain.
timeline.quote: Radha and Aron had not signed—and this made it seem like they wouldn't.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn presents the caged Phyrexian bird to the negotiators; three Benalish knights burst open into Phyrexian monsters and break the table.
timeline.quote: Three of the Benalish knights exploded outward from their armor.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
timeline.quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah opens a portal to New Argive's watchtower; Karn, Teferi, Stenn and Jodah escape while Jaya burns the room.
timeline.quote: Jaya grinned in triumph as she raised her hands in a blaze of fire and set the whole room alight.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian creature follows through the portal; Stenn locks down the watchtower and gives Karn the key, as they realize they cannot trust anyone.
timeline.quote: Stenn handed Karn the key.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Sand in the Hourglass" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Locked in the watchtower, Karn refuses to reveal the sylex's location or his plan until the group captures the Phyrexian spy and is sure of its members.
timeline.quote: "I have a plan to find and defeat Sheoldred," Karn said.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The group splits up to search the tower, Karn and Teferi taking the lower floors and Stenn the basement.
timeline.quote: "Jaya and I can take the upper floors," Jodah said.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn and Teferi find signs of the creature in the storage room and overhear Jodah and Jaya arguing through a vent.
timeline.quote: A throbbing chunk of meat had attached itself, barnacle-like, to the copper.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya fight the squid-like Phyrexian, which splits into pieces and escapes through the stone.
timeline.quote: The creature split again, this time into four small chittering beasts

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah makes locators from samples of the Phyrexian flesh, and Karn watches Ajani in a scryer.
timeline.quote: Ajani seemed to be fighting.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn tells Jodah the sylex is in a warehouse in Estark; the locators then point in every direction as creatures swarm Karn and Jodah.
timeline.quote: Creatures flung themselves at Karn and Jodah, cables outstretched and mouths seeking.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jaya saves Jodah and Karn with a blast of fire, which seems to sterilize the creatures.
timeline.quote: Flame roared throughout the room.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Stenn's cables ensnare Jaya, and Karn dismembers him as Jaya burns him; the tower's lockdown is lifted.
timeline.quote: He dismembered Stenn—no, not Stenn, the Phyrexian who had killed Stenn

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn calls the Weatherlight with the amulet and Shanna promises to come, while the group braces for the Phyrexians closing in.
timeline.quote: "You're in luck—we're not far.

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Locked Tower" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
timeline.quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets Meria in Yavimaya, who declines to commit her troops to Shiv.
timeline.quote: But travel to Shiv? No, I think not.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian dragon engine driven by Rona attacks Yavimaya, uprooting the Magnigoths.
timeline.quote: a dragon engine reared into Yavimaya's vacant blue skies.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Meria finds a Thran artifact in the mud; Jodah portals them away and it creates a vacuum that kills the dragon engine's organic parts.
timeline.quote: The Thran weapon had created a spherical vacuum.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona flees from the dragon engine, and Meria decides her people must fight.
timeline.quote: "Then there's only one path for us. And it doesn't lie in Yavimaya."

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah calls Karn to say Meria recruited neighboring groups and warns that there is a spy in the New Coalition.
timeline.quote: "There is a spy in the New Coalition."

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Magnigoths and Yavimayan elves arrive and drive the Phyrexians back; Jodah and Meria land on the deck on a kavu and Jodah shields the cannons.
timeline.quote: rank upon rank of Magnigoths marched forward, darkening Shiv's deserts with their cool shadows and verdant foliage.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jhoira triggers the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism and orders Jodah to portal everyone out.
timeline.quote: Jhoira had triggered the Mana Rig's self-destruct mechanism.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah portals Danitha, Radha, Meria and the troops to safety and steps through his final portal.
timeline.quote: Jodah pulled up a portal and threw Danitha, Radha, and Meria into it

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Jhoira organize the survivors, and Jodah, holding Karn's necklace and a lock of Jaya's hair, mourns her.
timeline.quote: I can't let go of her. I just got her back again.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jodah and Jhoira build a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert; Teferi leaves an empty pyramid for Karn.
timeline.quote: Jodah, Teferi, and Jhoira had remained to build this: a monument for Jaya.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jaya and Jodah agree to more fire against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "More fire?" Jaya asked. "More fire," Jodah agreed.

citation.text: Twinferno (Dominaria United, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rona seriously wounds Jodah at Urza's Tower and is wounded by Elspeth.
timeline.quote: However, she was wounded by Elspeth Tirel in return, and Tezzeret spirited her away.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah presides over a peace summit between the Keldons and New Benalia, interrupted by Karn and Teferi revealing the New Phyrexian invasion.
timeline.quote: The summit was interrupted when the planeswalkers Karn and Teferi revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah fights in the Battle at the Mana Rig as a leader of the New Coalition and delivers Jaya's eulogy.
timeline.quote: He helped create a memorial to Jaya after her death, and delivered her eulogy.

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah gives Teferi, Saheeli and Kaya Urza's time machine blueprints and is grievously wounded defending the tower from Rona's forces.
timeline.quote: he was grievously wounded while helping protect the tower from Rona 's forces

citation.text: "Jodah", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Jodah opens the Starfield Orb and is greeted by constructs of Mishra and Xantcha.
timeline.quote: constructs of Mishra and Xantcha , who greeted Jodah

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Simulacrum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rona assaults Urza's Tower, wounds Jodah, and is struck down by Elspeth; Tezzeret extracts her.
timeline.quote: Rona severely wounded Jodah with her glaive before being struck down by Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Jodah opens the Starfield Orb and is greeted by constructs of Xantcha and Mishra.
timeline.quote: In 4562 AR, Jodah opened the Starfield Orb left by Urza.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Simulacrum". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah gives Teferi Kjeldoran biscuits made by Saheeli's construct, and Teferi asks him to lead while he is away on the time machine.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to consider being that person.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 1: Stronghold" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Kaya find Jodah speaking with Jhoira, who asks if Teferi is still bent on going back in time.
timeline.quote: He's still bent on going back?

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah recognizes Urza's work in the orb and reveals Urza was the tower's builder, Teferi's teacher and his ancestor.
timeline.quote: Teferi's teacher. And my ancestor.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah reveals Thran script in the orb's cage reading, Go back to the beginning and greet me properly.
timeline.quote: It's the written language of the Thran, an ancient civilization on this plane,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Saheeli and Jodah find Kaya facing the spirit, who gives his name as Sharaman, the leader of Urza's armies.
timeline.quote: General Sharaman,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Epilogue: Jodah casts a shock spell at the Starfield Orb and is pulled into a pocket dimension resembling Urza's cabin.
timeline.quote: In a blue flash, the world vanished

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets constructs of Xantcha and Mishra, who accept him as a descendant of Urza.
timeline.quote: My name is Jodah, friend of Teferi's and descendant of Urza,

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah realizes the place is Urza's failsafe, the Legacy, and plans to tell Teferi; Mishra relays Urza's final words about ending conflicts.
timeline.quote: This whole place—it's Urza's failsafe in case he perished before he could deploy it against the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jodah, drinking in the hall, toast and reminisce about the dead Jaya.
timeline.quote: Let me have one turn on Saheeli's time machine, and I'd go back

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth joins them and speaks of Venser; Jodah reveals he is four thousand years old, and Chandra vows to save Ajani and burn the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: We're going to save him.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah unveils a staked trench and fire to impale the Phyrexian vanguard, and Elspeth and Jodah charge with powerstone lances that unleash scything bands of energy.
timeline.quote: Jodah unwove the phantasmal terrain spell he'd cast the previous day

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The skyship unfolds into a giant legged behemoth heading for the tower.
timeline.quote: Several more gargantuan legs sprouted from the bottom of the skyship's hull

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah leads Elspeth in casting Jaya's spell, and she channels her hope of saving Ajani, producing a blaze that destroys the behemoth.
timeline.quote: A column of radiance poured out of her

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona appears, blasts Elspeth and Jodah with lightning, and stabs Jodah in the gut as revenge for Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: This is for the trouble you caused me in Yavimaya,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 4: The Dark" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Elspeth stagger in alive; Elspeth announces she will go to New Phyrexia and Jodah will stay to free Teferi.
timeline.quote: Then I'm coming with you.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah figures out the portal spell but uses white mana, so it fails; he later learns it needs black mana and never completes it.
timeline.quote: but mistakenly used white mana instead of black, causing the spell to fail

citation.text: "Jarsyl", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The powerstone in the Anchor explodes, leaving Teferi unconscious, and Saheeli stays with Jodah to save him.
timeline.quote: Saheeli chose instead to stay behind with Jodah to try to save him

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Seven help Nissa Revane fend off Phyrexians attacking Urza's Tower and the Temporal Anchor, then help recover Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Seven helped Nissa Revane fend off the second line of Phyrexians attacking the tower

citation.text: "Wrenn", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aliana raises great silver statues on the grass flats of the Wastes.
timeline.quote: raised great silver statues on the grass flats of the Adarkar Wastes

citation.text: "Adarkar Wastes", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arcum shows Jodah and Gustha Ebbasdotter his weathervane, predicting a deepening winter; Jodah is skeptical.
timeline.quote: Although Arcum tried to prove to Jodah that these predictions were true, the Archmage Eternal was skeptical

citation.text: "Arcum Dagsson", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya thwart the plan; Garrisson and followers flee to Lim-Dul, are killed and added to his zombie army.
timeline.quote: they were killed and added to the necromancer 's zombie army.

citation.text: "Avram Garrisson", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ith summons the Rag Man to find a rescuer, and it brings back Jodah.
timeline.quote: The Rag Man obliged and brought back Jodah to the Conclave of Mages

citation.text: "Barl's Cage", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Sima destroy the cage; Ith falls, rises again, and destroys the Conclave in rage.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Sima managed to destroy the cage together

citation.text: "Barl's Cage", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jaya comes to rescue the prisoner Jodah; Chaeska catches them, but Jodah severs his arm and sets him on fire.
timeline.quote: Jodah severed one of his arms and set him on fire before he fled back to Lim-Dûl.

citation.text: "Chaeska", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah destroys the Lord of Tresserhorn, and Chaeska promises not to harm them.
